title: Oracle C2M Performance Tuning & Resource Optimization
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Make C2M fast — JVM, WebLogic, batch, and database
problem: As C2M load grows, performance problems surface across the stack — JVM/GC, WebLogic thread pools and connection pools, batch throughput, and database. This solution provides a measure-first tuning method for C2M and its WebLogic 14c middleware: find the real bottleneck and tune JVM/GC, server and data-source pools, batch, and SQL — turning a slow environment into a measured, optimized one, pilot-first.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the C2M performance model (JVM/GC → WebLogic pools → batch → database) and the measure-first tuning method.
Requirements Guide — what you need to tune (metrics/monitoring, environment access, workload profile) with how to verify each.

Tuning Method — ordered steps: measure and baseline, isolate the bottleneck, tune JVM/GC, WebLogic thread/connection pools, batch threadpools, and SQL/database, then re-measure and validate the gain, pilot-first.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with measured pass/fail gates plus Best Practices for repeatable, evidence-based tuning.
short: A measure-first C2M performance tuning method — JVM/GC, WebLogic pools, batch, and SQL — that turns a slow environment into a measured, optimized one, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
